title: Apexspace heading
description: The light (300) uppercase display heading at three fluid sizes: hero (42 → 72px), section (34 → 60px) and sub-head (29 → 44px), line-height 1.
notes: line breaks in the text (\n) are kept, so a title can be split where the design wants it
name: apexspace-heading

props.name: text
props.description: the heading text; a \n starts a new line

props.name: as
props.description: the HTML element; defaults to h2
